description: Implementation of the bindtextdomain(3) function for handling message catalog bindings in gettext, including setting and retrieving domain-specific directory and codeset bindings, with considerations for multi-threading and compatibility across different libc implementations.

methods.name: set_binding_values
methods.description: Sets or retrieves the directory and codeset bindings for a given domain, handling creation, modification, and lookup within a linked list of bindings, with thread safety.

methods.name: BINDTEXTDOMAIN
methods.description: Sets the directory for a specific message domain.

methods.name: BIND_TEXTDOMAIN_CODESET
methods.description: Sets the character encoding for a specific message domain.
